annotation.title_clean: A Strategic Roadmap by the Minister of State for Technology and AI
annotation.title_en: A Strategic Roadmap by the Minister of State for Technology and AI
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Minister of State for Information Technology and AI (OMSITAI), Lebanon
annotation.venue: Lebanon Office of the Minister of State for Technology and AI
annotation.summary_en: Slide-deck strategic roadmap from Lebanon's Minister of State for Technology and AI setting out the LEAP five-year strategy, new institutions (MITAI, Digital & AI Authority, Cybersecurity Institute, TDRA), draft data protection, cybersecurity and AI framework laws, and 2030 targets for AI-first government and investment. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish MITAI ministry via law pending in Parliament
Create independent Digital & AI Authority and Cybersecurity Institute/CERT reporting to the PM
Amend Law 431 to create an independent converged TDRA regulator
Draft Data Protection, Cybersecurity, e-Signature laws and National AI Framework under consultation
2030 targets: 80% digitized government services, US$500M AI investment, 15% labor productivity gain
